approvers: Managing partner/owner; main contractor or developer if on their job
reason: We spend about 500 euro a year on film and tape and it works. Paying around 19 a square metre, plus a 150 m2 minimum and a deposit, makes no sense for a four-man firm. I also don't want to learn something new that could mark coated glass or frames.
objection: It costs more than the film we already use, and in July and August half the façade is in full sun, so I don't know when you can even apply it or whether it peels cleanly off coated glass without marking the frames.
instead: Keep using self-adhesive film, plastic sheet and board with tape, applied and removed by our own labour.
would_change_my_mind: A price close to what film costs me now, plus a reference glazing contractor here who has had it applied and removed on coated glass in summer heat with no marks.
